app_documentation:
UniStudy is a comprehensive university student study platform designed to facilitate collaborative learning and knowledge sharing among students. The platform serves as a centralized hub where students can upload, browse, and download study notes shared by their peers, while also enabling them to form and participate in subject-specific study groups for real-time collaboration. Built with modern web technologies including React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, UniStudy provides a mobile-responsive interface optimized for both desktop and mobile devices, ensuring students can access educational resources anytime, anywhere.

The platform's core features include secure user registration and authentication using university email addresses, a robust study notes sharing system with search and filtering capabilities, study group formation and management, and real-time group chat functionality powered by Socket.io. Students can upload their notes to AWS S3 storage, making them accessible to the entire student community, while a rating and review system helps users identify high-quality content. The application supports multiple user roles including Students, Group Admins, and Platform Administrators, each with appropriate permissions and capabilities.

UniStudy is specifically designed for university students who need a reliable platform to share academic resources, collaborate with peers, and enhance their learning experience through community-driven knowledge exchange. The platform addresses common challenges students face such as finding quality study materials, connecting with classmates for group study sessions, and maintaining organized communication channels for academic discussions. With features like subject-based filtering, download tracking, and group member management, UniStudy creates an ecosystem that promotes academic success through peer collaboration.

The technical architecture leverages JWT for secure authentication, PostgreSQL for robust data management with proper indexing and relationships, and Socket.io for seamless real-time messaging. The mobile-first design approach ensures optimal user experience across devices, with a clean interface featuring bottom navigation, card-based layouts, and intuitive user flows. The platform's scalability is built into its foundation with UUID-based primary keys, efficient database schema design, and cloud-based file storage, positioning UniStudy to grow alongside its user base while maintaining performance and reliability.

glossary.Study Notes: Digital educational materials uploaded by students including lecture notes, summaries, practice problems, and study guides that are stored in AWS S3 and shared with the student community through the platform. Each note includes metadata such as subject, title, description, upload date, and user ratings.
glossary.Study Group: A collaborative learning space created by students focused on a specific subject or topic, where members can communicate through real-time chat, share resources, and coordinate study sessions. Groups have an admin who manages membership and settings, with a configurable maximum member limit.
glossary.Group Admin: A user role assigned to the creator of a study group who has additional permissions including managing group membership, moderating discussions, updating group settings, and maintaining the group's active status. The admin role is automatically assigned upon group creation.
glossary.JWT (JSON Web Token): A secure authentication mechanism used in UniStudy to verify user identity and maintain session state. After successful login, users receive a JWT token that must be included in subsequent API requests to access protected resources and features.
glossary.Rating System: A quality assessment feature allowing students to rate study notes on a scale of 1-5 stars and optionally provide written reviews. The system calculates and displays average ratings to help users identify high-quality educational content, with each user limited to one rating per note.
glossary.Socket.io: A real-time communication library enabling bidirectional WebSocket connections between the server and clients, used in UniStudy to power the group chat feature with instant message delivery, typing indicators, and message history synchronization across all group members.
